items.title: ARK-4 · final release
items.author: ARK Team
items.description: Pinned final ARK-4 custom firmware bundle. Upstream development has moved to ARK-5.
items.compatibility: Retail PSP-1000, 2000, 3000, Go and E1000 (Street); official 6.60/6.61 for the live-loader route. Existing CFW needs the separate official migration instructions.
items.install: Copy ARK_01234 to PSP/SAVEDATA and ARK_Loader to PSP/GAME on the same storage device. Launch ARK Loader from Game. Follow the official cIPL guide separately for permanent installation.
items.imageCredit: ARK Team · ICON0 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: CXMB · custom theme plugin
items.author: Poison and CXMB contributors; cello0314 fork
items.description: Theme plugin with relative-path loading fixes. Required for CTF themes; PTF files use the built-in theme menu.
items.compatibility: CXMB 3.71–6.61 Classic / Infinity lineage. Use a CTF made for the exact firmware; the collection below is pinned to the distributor’s stated versions.
items.install: Save as ms0:/seplugins/cxmb/cxmb.prx (Memory Stick) or ef0:/seplugins/cxmb/cxmb.prx (Go internal). On ARK-4 enable only VSH/XMB through Custom Launcher plugin installation, then restart VSH.
items.imageCredit: CXMB example: Jumbled theme · screenshot hosted by pspunk

items.title: Material Design Tiny White
items.author: JohnEdwa (as named in distributed file); hosted by pspunk
items.description: A compact Material-inspired XMB icon theme. Preview supplied by the theme distributor.
items.compatibility: Distributor lists 6.60 and 6.61; official or custom firmware. No CXMB needed.
items.install: Copy the PTF to ms0:/PSP/THEME/ or ef0:/PSP/THEME/ on Go internal storage. Apply in Settings → Theme Settings → Theme.

items.title: clearXMB black · PTF
items.author: Original author unlisted by distributor; hosted by pspunk
items.description: Dark XMB icon theme using the PSP’s native theme format. Preview supplied by pspunk.
items.compatibility: Distributor lists 6.60 and 6.61; official or custom firmware. No CXMB needed.
items.install: Copy clearXMBblack.ptf to ms0:/PSP/THEME/ or ef0:/PSP/THEME/. Select it in Settings → Theme Settings → Theme.

items.title: Jumbled · CTF 6.60
items.author: Original author unlisted by distributor; hosted by pspunk
items.description: A full XMB layout theme. Keep this 6.60-labelled original separate from PTF themes and converted CTF builds.
items.compatibility: File is explicitly jumbled660.ctf. Distributor lists its collection for 6.60/6.61; use on 6.60 CFW + CXMB. No independent 6.61/ARK-5 compatibility claim.
items.install: Copy to ms0:/PSP/THEME/ or ef0:/PSP/THEME/. Enable CXMB in VSH/XMB, restart VSH, then choose it in Theme Settings.

items.title: Allure v2 · CTF 6.60
items.author: Original author unlisted by distributor; hosted by pspunk
items.description: Alternative XMB styling with a matching distributor screenshot. This is the original 6.60-labelled CTF.
items.compatibility: 6.60 CFW + CXMB for this allure.v2.660.ctf build. Distributor also lists 6.61, but that has not been independently hardware-tested here.
items.install: Copy to ms0:/PSP/THEME/ or ef0:/PSP/THEME/. Enable CXMB only for VSH/XMB, restart VSH and apply through Theme Settings.

items.title: Apollo Save Tool
items.author: Damián Parrino (bucanero)
items.description: Manage PSP and PS1 saves, export/import and apply source-provided save patches.
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP. Save decryption requires game-specific keys; author documents SGKeyDumper / SGDeemer. Back up original saves before editing.
items.install: Extract APOLLO into PSP/GAME. Author scans Memory Stick saves in ms0:/PSP/SAVEDATA/ and PSP Go internal memory. Launch from Game.
items.imageCredit: Damián Parrino (bucanero) · ICON0 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: CMFileManager PSP
items.author: Joel16
items.description: File management, text editing, image/audio playback, archive extraction and FTP.
items.compatibility: Custom firmware. Standard build covers regular PSP and PSP Go without external M2. Use GO-M2 build if the PSP Go has an external memory card.
items.install: Merge the archive’s PSP folder into the storage root, producing PSP/GAME/CMFileManager/EBOOT.PBP. Keep every file together. Select the GO-M2 ZIP for PSP Go with external M2; standard ZIP for other setups. FTP: START → FTP connection, anonymous login, port 1337. Street has no WLAN.

files.name: CMFileManager-PSP-GO-M2.zip
files.label: PSP Go with external M2 memory

items.imageCredit: Joel16 · ICON0 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: OpenSupaplex
items.author: Sergio Padrino / sergiou87
items.description: Controller-friendly recreation of the classic puzzle game.
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP. Keep included data with the executable; author distributes original resources as freeware.
items.install: Extract the PSP package and copy its app folder intact into PSP/GAME.
items.imageCredit: Sergio Padrino / sergiou87 · PIC1 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: Ccleste
items.author: Celeste Classic authors; C port by leiflundgren; PSP port by fjtrujy
items.description: Native C port of Celeste Classic, packaged for PSP.
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP. This .tar.gz is a binary release asset, not a source archive. Preserve bundled data.
items.install: Extract the gzip/tar package on the computer and copy the folder containing EBOOT.PBP and its resources into PSP/GAME.
items.imageCredit: Celeste Classic authors; C port by leiflundgren; PSP port by fjtrujy · PIC1 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: Nazi Zombies: Portable
items.author: NZ:P team
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP. The project lists PSP-1000 PHAT and PSP-2000+ SLIM. This download is pinned to the recorded nightly build and checksum.
items.install: Author: extract the folder inside the PSP ZIP into PSP/GAME. Preserve all included maps and data.
items.imageCredit: NZ:P team · PIC1 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: DaedalusX64
items.author: DaedalusX64 team
items.description: Nintendo 64 emulator with PSP Media Engine audio support.
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP. Supply your own N64 ROMs; compatibility and speed vary per game.
items.install: Author: copy the entire DaedalusX64 folder into PSP/GAME. Keep emulator support files together.
items.imageCredit: DaedalusX64 team · PIC1 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: PicoDrive
items.author: Notaz and irixxxx contributors
items.description: Sega emulator; this asset is the native PSP build.
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP. Supply your own ROMs. Sega/Mega CD requires a suitable user-supplied BIOS. Feature availability and speed depend on PSP build and game.
items.install: Extract and retain the complete PSP package under PSP/GAME/PicoDrive. Consult included README for supported ROM and BIOS names.
items.imageCredit: Notaz and irixxxx contributors · ICON0 embedded in official PSP build
items.distributionNote: Original upstream download; private backup retained. The bundled readme restricts commercial redistribution.

items.title: Wagic, the Homebrew
items.author: WagicProject contributors
items.description: Customizable card game engine with computer opponents.
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP. This PSP package already contains WTH/Res game resources. The separate core archive is also preserved as an optional resource package; it is not a second required installation.
items.install: Copy the complete WTH folder to PSP/GAME/WTH/. Keep WTH/Res beside EBOOT.PBP. The optional matching core ZIP contains the resource folders at its root; these correspond to WTH/Res/, not PSP/GAME/ itself.
items.imageCredit: WagicProject contributors · PIC1 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: CrossCraft Classic
items.author: Nathan Bourgeois (IridescentRose), MotoLegacy / CrossCraft
items.description: Independent implementation of Minecraft Classic creative building.
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP; project is archived (May 2024). Official project describes Classic v0.30 creative mode, saves and multiplayer; not a Minecraft Java/Bedrock binary.
items.install: Create PSP/GAME/CrossCraft/ and extract all six files from the PSP ZIP into it: EBOOT.PBP, CrossCraft-Classic.prx, default.zip, config.cfg, LICENSE and README.md. Preserve default.zip as the bundled data archive. Multiplayer needs a WLAN-equipped model.
items.imageCredit: Nathan Bourgeois (IridescentRose), MotoLegacy / CrossCraft · PIC1 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: Homebrew Sorter Ultimate
items.author: wad11656
items.description: Sort XMB apps, alphabetize categories and manage PSP Go storage.
items.compatibility: Custom firmware. On PSP Go run from Memory Stick to access Memory Stick storage. Categories can use author's bundled plugin or an existing category_lite.prx.
items.install: Author: copy PSP/GAME/Homebrew Sorter Ultimate to the matching PSP/GAME directory. No Animations edition omits animation frames and XMB song. Use Storage Device selector for Memory Stick/System Storage.
items.imageCredit: wad11656 · PIC1 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: PKGi PSP
items.author: bucanero
items.description: On-device downloader with a homebrew database and ZIP installation support.
items.compatibility: Custom firmware and a WLAN-equipped PSP for downloads. This homebrew-db package contains a homebrew catalogue. Content requiring a license also requires your own valid console activation and license.
items.install: Copy the full PKGI folder to PSP/GAME/. The homebrew-db asset includes the homebrew list. Config and pkgi.txt live with the app. PSP Go defaults to internal ef0 storage; set storage ms0 in its config to choose Memory Stick. Network use requires WLAN.
items.imageCredit: bucanero · ICON0 embedded in official PSP build

items.title: ScummVM
items.author: ScummVM team
items.description: Adventure game interpreter with a current native PSP package.
items.compatibility: Homebrew-enabled PSP and supported game data you own or official freeware data. All plugins must match exact ScummVM version. 81 MiB official PSP package; updated 18 October 2026.
items.install: Copy the full scummvm folder to PSP/GAME/. Keep its exact-version plugin folder and kbd.zip with EBOOT.PBP. Add supported game data through the launcher. Source paths: ms0:/scummvm_savegames/ and ms0:/scummvm.ini; check ARK Go redirection before assuming an ef0 path.
items.imageCredit: ScummVM team · PIC1 embedded in official PSP build
